title: Composition and dualizing tensor calculus for integration transposes
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be compactifiable separated finite-type maps between Noetherian schemes. Work in the ordinary small-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] with compact support $F_f=Rf_!$, $F_g=Rg_!$, $F_h=R(gf)_!$ and actual right adjoints $R_f,R_g,R_h$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Use the proper/open triangle-normalized compositor $\alpha:F_gF_f\xrightarrow{\sim}F_h$ [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and its adjunction-preserving right mate $c:R_h\xrightarrow{\sim}R_fR_g$, with the composite Hom bijection [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction].

Choose $W_f\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $W_g\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and traces $t_f:F_fW_f\to A_Y$, $t_g:F_gW_g\to A_Z$. Put $W_h=f^*W_g\otimes W_f$, and choose $t_h:F_hW_h\to A_Z$ satisfying
$$t_h\alpha_{W_h}=t_gF_g\bigl((1\otimes t_f)P_{f;W_g,W_f}^{-1}\bigr).$$
For each $a=f,g,h$ write $P_{a;K,M}:K\otimes_A^LF_aM\to F_a(a^*K\otimes_A^LM)$ for the canonical compact-support projection map, built from the proper projection map and the open-extension tensor comparison on a compactification [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], with derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Assume all canonical projection maps used with $W_f,W_g,W_h$ are invertible on all inputs. Let $\gamma_{a,K}:a^*K\otimes W_a\to R_aK$ be the transpose of $(1_K\otimes t_a)P_{a;K,W_a}^{-1}$ for $a=f,g,h$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Let $a_K:h^*K\otimes W_h\xrightarrow{\sim} f^*(g^*K\otimes W_g)\otimes W_f$ be reassociation. Then
$$\gamma_{h,K}=c_K^{-1}\gamma_{f,R_gK}(f^*\gamma_{g,K}\otimes1_{W_f})a_K.$$

Set $\omega_f=R_fA_Y$. Let $\theta_{f,L}:f^*L\otimes\omega_f\to R_fL$ be the transpose of $(1_L\otimes\varepsilon_{f,A_Y})P_{f;L,\omega_f}^{-1}$ whenever that projection map is invertible. Then
$$\theta_{f,L}(1\otimes\gamma_{f,A_Y})=\gamma_{f,L}.$$
For the vector-bundle specialization $W_f=A_X(r)[2r]$, $W_g=A_Y(s)[2s]$, projection with $\omega_f$ is invertible if $\gamma_{f,A_Y}$ is invertible. The formula therefore uses precisely the orientation at the unit followed by the dualizing tensor map, including ambient inputs $R_gK$. The ordered twist/shift associators carry no block-interchange sign since $(-1)^{(2r)(2s)}=1$.

proof.text: Unit normalization identifies orientation with the actual adjoint transpose of the trace. Thus F_f(orientation) followed by the counit is t_f. Naturality of the coefficient-first projection in its sheaf argument gives an inverse-projection square. Apply it to orientation, tensor the counit, and use this identity; left naturality and injectivity of the Hom equivalence give the orientation/theta clause.

proof.text: The ordered integration composition lemma gives the equality before transposing. Apply the composite-adjunction Hom bijection and the adjunction-preserving right-mate isomorphism to that equality. Projection naturality in the coefficient variable implies naturality of integration, hence naturality of gamma. Applying this to gamma_g moves R_f(gamma_g) across gamma_f and gives exactly the stated four-arrow composition formula.

The delivery has 0 new nodes. The item's statement and stmt_deps match the base byte for byte: they are the Q106 reviewer-FIX version, so nothing is weakened. There is no SGA citation and no repair note for this item. The source (main-20261015 cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity.proof.md ¶2) says only 'transposing'; the 8 steps write that calculation out, and the proof is marked agent-written. I re-derived each step by hand. Step 2 builds the compact-support projection tensor law from three cited facts: the first identity of lem-sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition, naturality of the proper projection, and the open two-coefficient law of Step 1. The unit law comes from the definition of PF plus lem-weil-pbc-adjunct-counit-identity. Step 3: εF(θ(1⊗v)) = (1⊗t_f)Q = u_{f,L}. Steps 4–5 combine the composite Hom bijection, naturality of Q_f along γ_g, the factorisation γ_g⊗t_f = γ_g(1⊗t_f), the tensor law at (g^*K, W_g, W_f), and naturality of Q_g along β. Step 6 inverts lem-amb-shriek-tensor-composition at W_h (the node states the inverse form), cancels α_{W_h} with the trace hypothesis, and identifies the transpose of c_Kγ_h as u_hα_S through the mate formula with L2=F_gF_f, L1=F_h; the h→fg direction checks out. Step 7 is a naturality square. Step 8: the sign (−1)^{(2r)(2s)} = +1 follows from the signed-coherence node. Small case f=g=id: both sides of the composition formula equal 1⊗t_g⊗t_f, and θ(1⊗t_f) = γ_{f,L}. A depth-first search over all dependencies found no cycle. Duplicate candidates checked: lem-pur-composition-tensor-mate and lem-pur-smooth-exceptional-tensor-pasting are narrower pro-étale D^b_ctf nodes, and lem-amb-vector-integration-tensor-counit makes a different claim. Accepted tool_uses: generic off-route nodes lem-sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition, lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor and def-kun-projection-formula-map. One minor point needs no action: the hypothesis that all projection maps are invertible is redundant, because the proper projection and open comparison nodes already make them isomorphisms. Details are in review.md.
